## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to set the fallback IANA time zone a calendar's members are reckoned in when an individual event states no zone of its own.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting more than one (it is functional — one default per calendar) and avoid relying on it for an event whose own offset differs; that event carries [`gmeow:eventTimeZone`](gmeow-eventTimeZone.md).

### How to use

- Point the calendar at one [`gmeow:TimeZone`](../classes/gmeow-TimeZone.md); let per-event [`gmeow:eventTimeZone`](gmeow-eventTimeZone.md) override it where the occurrence sits in a different civil offset.

### Examples

- ex:workCal [`gmeow:calendarTimeZone`](gmeow-calendarTimeZone.md) ex:torontoZone.
